name: Nose

platformNotes.note: Used for sniffing-out-coded drama and adult-coded intuition tweets. The nose is the visible 'I smell something' default across close-friends replies.
Common in aesthetic-coded smell shares and gossip-coded stories. The nose reads as the visible nosy-coded default on story overlays and reply captions.

seoDescription: Learn what the Nose emoji 👃 really means.

longForm.overview:
The 👃 Nose emoji was added in Unicode 6 (2010) and is drawn as a human nose with visible nostrils, presented in profile. The visual cue reads instantly as smell-coded reference, sniffing-out default, or the visible 'I am being nosy' tag. By 2026 👃 has become the go-to emoji for the smell-coded reaction, the visible nosy default, and the intuition-coded reaction in close-friends and family chats.

In modern chat 👃 does very specific work. People send it as a literal smell-coded reference, as the visible 'I am sniffing out gossip' tag, or as the intuition-coded default. The nose with visible nostrils is the visual cue that the read is nosy-coded. Writers should pick 👃 when the read is sniffing-out energy or visible 'I smell drama' tag, and avoid it when the read is just a face feature — 👃 itself remains the body-part emoji.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
👃 lands on a friend's gossip message, in a work channel where someone is signaling intuition-coded energy, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is signaling playful suspicion. The nose with visible nostrils anchors the read.

In close-friends chats 👃 reads as the universal nosy default and the visible 'I am sniffing it out' tag. On X the emoji punctuates intuition-coded and gossip tweets. The emoji pairs with 👀 for the layered nosy-and-side-eye stack and with 🍵 for the layered sniffing-out-and-tea stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 👃 in any context where the read is casual conversation only. The nose implies sniffing-out-coded, not just idle chat. Avoid 👃 in formal contexts where the nosy-coded read lands as gossipy.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 👃 on a sniffing-out-coded message, mirror with another 👃 or 👀 to send matching energy. The nosy chain reads as solidarity.

If 👃 lands as the intuition default, reply with another 👃 or 🔍. And if you want to send 👃 yourself, pair it with the moment so the sniffing-coded read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 👃 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 👃 means smell-coded reference, sniffing-out energy, or the visible 'I am being nosy' reaction. The nose with visible nostrils is the visual cue that the read is nosy-coded.

faqs.question: Is 👃 flirty?
faqs.answer: Rarely. 👃 usually reads as nosy-coded rather than flirty; in a dating thread it can read as 'I am sniffing things out' tag content.

faqs.question: What does 👃 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl or anyone, 👃 carries the same nosy-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 👃 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram, 👃 is the default sticker on gossip-coded captions and aesthetic-coded nosy story overlays.
